comment: Endless Arena waves (docs/ARENA.md Part 5). Enemy budget = baseCount + perWave x (wave - 1), up to maxCount (minions count half). Enemies come from the weeks unlocked by waveForWeek; every 5th wave is an elite wave, every 10th a remixed boss. Between waves the party gets breatherMp MP back, no HP.

cardReward.comment: PT Part 6: after every wave, pick 1 of 'choices' cards or skip for skipScraps. Rarity weights move from 'early' to 'late' by wave lateWave; cards in the party's Vectors are weighted by partyVectorWeight; newVectorChance is the chance one offer is a Vector nobody in the party knows.

checkpointPick.comment: PT Part 6: every checkpoint, one party member picks 1 of 'choices' perks (Techniques once PT Part 8 lands).
